messages:
maria: kicking off canary for release/2026.03.21 svc-search. Enabling feature flag `model_route_v2` at 5% (cohort: canary). Deploy bot will pin model-version 3.2.1 for canary. Change window: 21:00-23:00 UTC. I'll monitor latency and 5xx.

deploy-bot: ✅ Canary enable request received. Flag: model_route_v2 -> 5% cohort=canary. Pinned version: model-serving:3.2.1. Rollout ID: rlt-7001112223. Will post health pings every 60s.

ben: noted. I'll watch SLOs. oncall dave?

dave: oncall here. I'll take alerts. Quick ask: what's rollback criteria?

maria: primary: 5xx > 1% sustained 5m OR p95 latency increase > 30% vs baseline. Secondary: quality regressions from eval set (fn: promptset/canary-critical). If triggered, auto-rollback to model-serving:3.2.0 and FF back to 0%.

clara: can we add a QoS lock on routing so traffic doesn't spike if autoscaler lags? propose `qos_lock=true` in rollout policy.

maria: yes adding. @deploy-bot set rollout_policy.qos_lock = true

deploy-bot: Command accepted. rollout_policy.qos_lock=true. Autoscale buffers=20%.

ben: seeing slight p95 bump at t+3m +12% — still within threshold. telemetry shows redis cache miss spike.

clara: flipping on cache warmup for the canary nodes: `kubectl exec -c preloader ...` will run preload. doing now.

deploy-bot: Preload job started for canary nodes. Job ID: preload-7001112223-a

dave: alert: spike in 5xx at t+8m -> 1.4% over 2m, trending up.

maria: ok initiating mitigation: reduce flag to 1% and pause ramp. @deploy-bot set model_route_v2=1% and pause_rollout.

deploy-bot: Applied: model_route_v2=1%, rollout paused. Noting pinned version remains model-serving:3.2.1. Action id: act-4432.

ben: after reducing, 5xx dropped to 0.5% in next interval. latency p95 back to +5%.

dave: logs show backend worker OOMs around canary nodes — looks like quantized kernel regression with 3.2.1. Ops suggests revert.

maria: decision: roll back model-serving to 3.2.0 for canary and disable flag (0%). We'll mark this as rollback and open a bug. @clara can you file release note + regression ticket?

clara: filed bug #INF-712: '3.2.1 quant kernel OOM on canary' and PRD note in release_notes/2026-03-21.md. Also set flag to 0% via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback: model-serving -> 3.2.0 on pinned canary (rlt-7001112223). model_route_v2=0%. Rollback complete. health checks green.

maria: thanks all. We'll hold main rollout until kernel fix. Callout for release notes: mark rollback and QoS lock decision. Postmortem if fix takes >24h.

dave: adding to oncall handoff: monitor earlier canary nodes for any stragglers. :eyes:

ben: thumbs up. After we have a kernel patch, propose staggered canary with warmup + qos_lock again.
